contributions.detail: SIX itemised rows sum to EXACTLY 1234.28 (100 + 200 + 276,42 + 250 + 100 + 307,86), which equals cover line 1 in BOTH the THIS REPORT and CUMULATIVE cells; the LAST-REPORT column is blank on every line, so this is the first and only report of the cycle and the two scopes coincide — recorded as 'cumulative' per the addendum's coincidence rule. THE SUB-$50 AGGREGATE TRAP IS LIVE ON THIS PAGE AND WAS AVOIDED: the filer wrote a SEVENTH ink line on Form A reading 'Various < 50%' with amount 2372,52 in the Amount column and no date and no address. That line is the statutory $50-or-less AGGREGATE — it equals cover line 2 (2372.52) exactly — and the Carr form puts it on the cover, never in the itemisation. It is NOT emitted as a contribution row: doing so would invent a donor named 'Various' and would double-count against filing_totals.stated_total_contributions, which already publishes line1+line2. Scoring the six real rows against line1+line2 (3606.80) would likewise have manufactured a false mismatch. Form A prints no schedule total; the cover line is the only anchor.

expenditures.detail: ⚠ HUMAN LOOK RECOMMENDED. p3 Form B is COMPLETELY BLANK — verified full-page at 200 dpi and again on a 600 dpi crop of the top band (x=0 y=620 W=5100 H=900), which shows only reverse-side bleed-through and no filer ink on any of the ~40 writing lines. Yet the cover states campaign expenses of 3606.80 in BOTH the THIS and CUMULATIVE cells, and the balance chain below proves that figure is real. So the itemisation the filer was required to attach is simply absent from the document: zero rows against a printed 3606.80. Recorded as a delta with both figures named — 0.00 itemised vs 3606.80 stated — rather than as a clean zero, because calling it 'exact' would assert the candidate spent nothing. Scope is 'unknown' because with no rows there is no row sum to match against either printed cell (and the two cells are equal in any case).
